messages:
taylor: postmortem takeaway: we're seeing the same regression fingerprint across three incidents — variability on billing prompts + occasional tokenizer cold starts. We need tests that detect pattern-level regressions, not just single-case fixes.

anika: Agree. My proposal: three layers of artifacts: 1) curated prompt sets (billing, auth, safety), 2) regression suites that run heuristics across historical incident prompts, 3) short load spikes + a small chaos drill to exercise fallbacks.

ben: I'll own the regression suites. plan: assemble the historic-failure corpus (from the three incidents), write token-diff and semantic-stability checks, and add a weekly job that fails if metric drift > threshold. Target: draft PR in 5 days.

sam: I'll build the prompt sets. two files: incident-patterns/billing.yaml and incident-patterns/safety.yaml. each prompt entry will include origin_note and sample_response. I'll anonymize PII with the standard tool. PR by Wed.

maya: ops: can we run a 2-step chaos drill in staging next Tue? step1: evict a GPU pod; step2: simulate a control-plane latency spike. Keep it 25m and limited to staging. ops-bot can schedule.

ops-bot: Scheduled: Pattern-driven chaos drill  incident-patterns  Tue 14:00 UTC (25m) on staging. Invite sent to eng-ml, eng-sre, oncall. Runbook link: https://go/drills/patterns-199. Reminder 24h prior. :robot_face:

anika: For load tests: short bursts 90-120s at 180-220 qps, record p50/p95/p99 and token cost. Add these as nightly optional jobs. If regressions are detected, mention exact failing prompt IDs so owners can triage.

taylor: Ownership matrix: regression suites -> ben; prompt sets + anonymizer -> sam; load harness + CI -> anika; chaos coordination -> maya + ops-bot; postmortem linking + tracking -> taylor.

ben: About model variants: I'll run suites across matrix variants: v1.4, v1.4-quant, and v1.5-rc. will add GH action matrix and an artifacts uploader for failed-case traces.

sam: I'll include repro steps, tags, and an example of expected good output to make triage faster. file path: infra/evals/promptsets/patterns-199-billing.yaml

anika: For the weekly drift job, propose thresholds: semantic-stability < 0.85 (embedding sim) or token-diff > 5% triggers a fail. open to tweaking.

taylor: Deadlines: owners to post draft PRs and link to postmortem issue #199 by next Mon EOD. If anyone needs an extension, call it out now.

maya: ops-bot: please post a quick checklist in the drill doc: emergency-stop env, runbook section for rolling back, and contact list.

ops-bot: Checklist added to runbook. Emergency-stop flag: DRILL_HALT=true. Will post drill aftermath notes after run. :robot_face:

ben: ack. I'll start the corpus export now: `python infra/tools/export_incident_corpus.py --ids 112,147,199 --out incidents-corpus.json`.

sam: ack. I'll scrub logs with: `python infra/tools/anonymize.py --in incidents-corpus.json --out incidents-corpus-sanitized.json` before committing promptsets.

anika: I'll prototype the load job and open a draft CI job tonight.

taylor: Thanks everyone. we'll reconvene for a 20m check-in the day after the drill to review results and promote any failing checks to gating if needed. Please post PR links here.

ben: posting note: will include failing-case reporting to S3 with a small TTL so we can inspect traces.

ops-bot: Reminder will be sent 24h before drill.
